metaDescription: Live status of OrangenBot, the dashboard and the database.

lead.operational: Every bot shard is up, and the dashboard and database respond quickly.
lead.degraded: Something is slow or not responding — everything else works.
lead.down: The bot or the database is unreachable right now. Settings saved on the web apply once it recovers.

shardsHint: Each shard reports every 30 seconds; after 2 minutes of silence it counts as down.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed — showing the last known status.
noShards: The bot has not reported its status yet.
